scope: Independent dedicated browser rendering proof; actual production PDF worker/renderPdfPage and validateDraftImage/browser image decoder. No App, Tauri IPC, persisted area draft, installed binary or Agent.
oracle: Literal source-PDF CropBox/clockwise rotation and JPEG EXIF edge transforms, independent of product coordinate helper. Actual decoded magenta marker bounds measured from canvas pixels; <=1.01 pixel tolerance for edge rasterization. Ready page identity and all oriented raster dimensions checked separately.
coverage: PDF CropBox [40,70,340,570], page rotations 0/90/180/270, UserUnit 1 and 2
JPEG EXIF tags 1 through 8; static PNG/GIF/WebP
No unexpected browser errors or external requests in passing runs

retainedFirstChromium.cause: Source collector included all runtime test files; only a non-imported test file changed during root work. This is not a rendering failure or a stable whole-runtime checkpoint.
retainedFirstChromium.correction: Preserved runner bytes; collect production local JavaScript imports and Worker URLs after stripping type-only imports, plus package lock/config/PDF.js implementation/fixtures and dedicated harness. One Chromium rerun obtained stable 39-input proof.

screenshotsActuallyViewed.meaning: Final static WebP surface only; confirms the visible colored marker/corners, not all nineteen render outputs or full App layout.

limitations: Standalone browser renderer proof does not verify area pointer/numeric interaction, feedback ownership, cold persistence, full App layout, Tauri WebKit/CSP or native install. These remain separate.
Both dedicated page runs use the browser default DPR; full App DPR 1/2 and interaction cases are prepared but not run in this checkpoint.

Prior independent Poppler reference did not demonstrate UserUnit physical scaling. This production renderer checkpoint records the actual canvas dimensions per page without widening that Poppler claim.
Synthetic font-free PDFs do not request external fonts/cmaps; packaged implementation+lock are hashed but not all unused font assets.
Original JSON raw bytes preserved; formatted JSONs were verified semantically identical.
